events.description: Called with the id of the command chosen; the palette then closes.
events.name: onAction

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The groups of commands to offer, in order.
props.name: sections

props.description: The search field's hint; "Search commands" by default.
props.name: placeholder

props.description:
The key that opens it: one letter means Cmd or Ctrl with it (`k`, the default), or a whole binding (`mod+shift+p`);
`false` for none. On web it is registered with the shortcut registry (ADR 0508), so a person can remap it.
props.name: hotkey

props.description: False leaves out the "Actions" section, which lists every action the shortcut registry holds. Defaults to true.
props.name: hasRegisteredActions

props.description: False to leave out the "Ask Tamo" entry (shown with the AI module installed and on for the screen, ADR 0507).
props.name: ai

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen
